verses.text: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
lines: God presides in the great assembly.

verses.text: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?”
lines: and show partiality to the wicked?”

verses.text: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
lines: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless.
Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

verses.text: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
lines: Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

verses.text: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
lines: They don’t know, neither do they understand.
They walk back and forth in darkness.
All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

verses.text: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
lines: all of you are sons of the Most High.

verses.text: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
lines: Nevertheless you shall die like men,
and fall like one of the rulers.”

verses.text: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
lines: for you inherit all of the nations.
